title: The order of schools: NYU pre-med, Copland, Juilliard, back to NYU
summary: He sorts out the sequence of NYU pre-med, Copland, Juilliard and NYU music courses, being asked to leave most of them.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Was your Copland experience during that year; was it at Julliard?
It may have been in between leaving college and going to Julliard; I'm not sure, or it may have been right after Julliard. No, no, it was before Julliard.
I went from Julliard--I went from college to Copland to Julliard and back to college but in the post grad music courses.
We managed to skip over the college experience. What school was it?
This is while I was still a pre-med student.
Were you a good pre-med student?
I was asked to leave college, I was asked to leave Julliard. I asked myself to leave Copland, I was asked to leave N.Y.U. when I went back there as a music student. As a student I was bad.
What brought you back? By this time you should catch onto your own pattern, why did you come back?
I knew that I wanted to continue in music, I was just reaching out in all directions, trying to find a place that would fit, that would feel right, and so I kept looking. But nothing felt right.
